description: The payment state of the order (unpaid, pending, paid), its last attempt and the next step. After a failed or cancelled payment the cart is open again and place_order starts a new attempt. Needs the order reference from start_order (Authorization: Bearer mo1_… or the ref argument).

ref.description: Order reference (mo1_…) from start_order, only when the client cannot send it as Authorization: Bearer

title: Check payment
